summary: Cloopen Group Holding Ltd. filed a 6-K announcing a definitive merger agreement to go private. The transaction, with an implied equity value of ~$162.89 million, will be led by a consortium including founder and CEO Changxun Sun. Shareholders (other than the Buyer Group) will receive $0.4940 per share or $2.9641 per ADS, a 51.23% premium to the December 19, 2025 closing price. The Buyer Group, holding 28.42% of shares (57.25% voting power), has signed support agreements to vote in favor. The merger is structured as a Cayman Islands statutory merger; regulatory timing and potential dissenting shareholder issues are key watchpoints.
